G5500.def:
χειρο-τονέω, -ῶ
(χείρ, τείνω)
__1. to vote by stretching out the hand in the Athenian ἐκκλησία (Luc., Plut.).
__2. to appoint:
__(a) by vote, 2Co 8:19
__(b) without vote, At 14:23 (see Rackham, in l) (cf. προχειροτονέω).†
(AS)

G5501.def:
χείρων, -ον, compar. of κακός
[in LXX: 1Rs 17:43 B, Wis.15:18 17:6, 3Ma.5:20 * ;]
worse: Mt 9:16 12:45 27:64, Mc 2:21, Lc 11:26, Jo 5:14, 1Tm 5:8, Hb 10:29, 2Pe 2:20; εἰς (ἐπὶ) τὸ χεῖρον, Mc 5:26, 2Tm 3:13.†
(AS)

G5502.def:
Χερουβείν (Rec. -βίμ), τά (Heb. כְּרוּב),
Cherubim: Hb 9:6 (cf. Êx 25:17 (18), al.; see DB, i, 377 ff.).†
(AS)

G5503.def:
χήρα, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for אַלְמָנָה ;]
a widow: Mt 23:13 (Rec., R, mg.), Mc 12:40-43, Lc 2:37 4:25 7:12 18:3, 5 20:47 21:2-3, At 6:1 9:39, 41, 1Co 7:8, 1Tm 5:3-5 5:11 5:16, Tg 1:27; γυνὴ χ., Lc 4:26; of one of an ordo viduarum (see CGT, in l), 1Tm 5:9; metaphorically, of a city forsaken, Ap 18:7.†
(AS)

G5504.def:
ἐχθές
(Rec. χθές), adv., [in LXX for תְּמוֹל, etc. ;]
yesterday: Jo 4:52, At 7:28, Hb 13:8 (on the form, see Rutherford, NPhr., 370 f.).†
ἐχθές,
adverb ={χθές}, yesterday, ( 5th-6th c.BC: Aristophanes Comicus “Nubes” 175, “Th.” 616, etc.; ἀπ᾽ ἐ. “Anthologia Graeca” 11.35 (1st c.BC: Philodemus Gadarensis Epigrammaticus); μέσφα τό γ᾽ ἐ. 3rd c.BC: Theocritus Poeta Bucolicus 2.144 ); οὐ γάρ τι νῦν γε κἀ. today or yesterday, ( 5th c.BC: Sophocles Tragicus “Antigone” 456; οὐκ ἐ. οὐδὲ πρῴην 5th c.BC: Antipho Orator “fragment” 58 ); ἐ. καὶ τρίτης [ἡμέρας] ( LXX.Ruth.2.11, compare 2nd c.AD: Marcus Antoninus Imperator 10.7. (ἐχθές is commoner than χθές) in Comedy texts and LXX, is the only form used in “NT”, and frequently in papyri of all periods, ( “PSI” 4.442.21 (3rd c.BC), etc.)) (AS)

G5505.def:
χιλιάς, -άδος, ἡ
(χίλιοι), [in LXX for אֶלֶף ;]
the number one thousand, a thousand: Lc 14:31, At 4:4, 1Co 10:8, Ap 5:11 7:4-8 11:13 14:1, 3 21:16.†
(AS)

G5506.def:
χιλίαρχος (in Hdt., al., -ης), -ου, ὁ
(χίλιοι, ἄρχω) [in LXX chiefly for אַלּוּף שַׂר ;]
a chiliarch, the commander of a thousand, esp. a Roman military tribune, the commander of a cohort: Jo 18:12, At 21:31-33, 37 22:24-29 23:10, 15 23:17-19, 22 24:7, 22 25:23; more generally, of officers of similar rank, Mc 6:21, Ap 6:15 19:18 (see, DB, i, 352b; DCG, i, 271a, 307a).†
(AS)

G5508.def:
χίος, -ου, ἡ
Chios, an island in Ægean Sea: At 20:15.†
(AS)

G5509.def:
χιτών, ῶνος, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for כְּתֹנֶת:]
the garment worn next the skin (though two tunics were sometimes worn, see Swete, Mk., 117), a tunic: Mt 10:10, Mc 6:9 14:63, Lc 3:11 9:3, Ju 23; dieting. from ἱμάτιον (which see), Mt 5:40, Lc 6:29, Jo 19:23, At 9:39 (see DCG, i, 338, 340, 499)
(AS)

G5510.def:
χιών, -όνος, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for שֶׁלֶג also (in Da) for תְּלַג ;]
snow: Mt 28:3, Ap 1:14.†
(AS)

G5511.def:
χλαμύς, -ύδος, ἡ
[in LXX: 2Ma.12:35 * ;]
a chlamys, or short cloak worn over the χιτών (which see): Mt 27:28, 31 (see Tr., Syn., § 1).†
(AS)

G5512.def:
χλευάζω
(χλεύη, a jest), [in LXX: Wis.11:14, 2Ma.7:7, 4Ma.5:22 * ;]
to jest, mock, jeer: At 17:32.†
(AS)

G5513.def:
χλιαρός, -ά, -όν
(χλίω, to become warm),
warm, tepid; metaphorically, of persons, luke-warm: Ap 3:16.†
(AS)

G5515.def:
χλωρός, -ά, -όν
(χλόη), [in LXX for יֶרֶק, etc. ;]
__(a) pale green: χόρτος, Mc 6:39, Ap 8:7; πᾶν χ., Ap 9:4;
__(b) pale: ἵππος, Ap 6:8.†
(AS)

G5518.def:
χοῖνιξ, -ικος, ἡ
[in LXX: Eze.45:10-11 (בַּת) * ;]
a chænix, a dry measure of rather less than a quart: Ap 6:6 (EV, measure).†
(AS)

G5520.def:
χολάω, -ῶ
(χολή), [in LXX: 3Ma.3:1 R * ;]
__1. to be melancholy mad (Aristoph.).
__2. = χολοῦμαι, to be angry: with dative of person(s), Jo 7:23.†
(AS)

G5521.def:
χολή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX for רֹאשׁ, לַעֲנָה, מְרֵרָה ;]
gall: Mt 27:34 (here prob. = myrrh, cf. Mc 15:23, see Swete, in l; DCG, i, 634); metaphorically, At 8:23.†
(AS)

G5522.def:
χοῦς, -οός accusative, οῦν, ὁ, (contr. from χόος),
[in LXX chiefly for עָפָר ;]
__1. earth, soil.
__2. In later writers (Pint., LXX), = κονιορτός, dust: Mc 6:11, Ap 18:19.†
(AS)

G5523.def:
Χοραζείν (Rec. -ζίν), ἡ,
Chorazin, a town of Galilee: Mt 11:21, Lc 10:13.†
(AS)

G5524.def:
χορηγέω, -ῶ
(χορός, ἡγέομαι) [in LXX for כּוּל pilp. ;]
__1. to lead a χορός (see LS, see word).
__2. to defray the cost of a χορός.
__3. In late writers, metaphorically, with accusative (see M, Pr., 65), to supply, furnish abundantly: 2Co 9:10, 1Pe 4:11 (Polyb., al.).†
(AS)

G5525.def:
χορός, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for מָחוֹל, מְחֹלָה ;]
a dance: pl., Lc 15:25.†
(AS)

G5526.def:
χορτάζω
(χόρτος), [in LXX for שָׂבַע, Sl 17:14 al. ;]
__(a) prop., of animals (see Lft. on Fp 4:12), to feed, fatten: Ap 19:21;
__(b) in late Gk. (Kennedy, Sources, 82, 156), of persons, to fill or satisfy with food: with accusative of person(s), Mt 15:33; pass., Mt 14:20 15:37, Mc 6:42 7:27 8:8, Lc 9:17, Jo 6:26, Tg 2:16; opposite to πεινᾶν, Fp 4:12; with genitive of thing(s), Mc 8:4; ἀπό, Lc 16:21; ἐκ, Lc 15:16, WH, txt.; metaphorically, Mt 5:6, Lc 6:21.†
(AS)

G5527.def:
χόρτασμα, -τος, τό
(χορτάζω), [in LXX: Gn 24:25, 32 42:27 43:24, Jz 19:19 (מִסְפּוֹא), Dt 11:16 (עֶשֶׂב), (Sir.33:24) Sir.38:26 * ;]
fodder (Polyb., Plut., al.): pl., At 7:11 (RV, sustenance).†
(AS)

G5528.def:
χόρτος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for עֶשֶׂב, also for חָצִיר, etc. ;]
__1. an enclosure, a feeding place (Hom.).
__2. food, esp. for cattle, grass: Mt 13:26 14:19, Mc 4:28 6:39, Lc 12:28, Jo 6:10, 1Co 3:12, Tg 1:10-11, 1Pe 1:24" (LXX), Ap 9:4; χ. χλωρός, Mc 6:39, Ap 8:7.†
(AS)

G5530.def:
χράομαι, χρῶμαι
(χρή), [in LXX for עָשָׂה, etc. ;]
to use, make use of: with dative (cf. M, Pr., 64, 158), At 27:17, 1Co 9:12 9:15, 1Tm 1:8 5:23; μᾶλλον χρῆσαι (i.e. the opportunity; see M, Pr., 247), 1Co 7:21; as some­times in late writers (cf. M, Pr., 64; Lft., Notes, 233), with accusative, 1Co 7:31; of feelings, etc., to exercise, shew: 2Co 1:17 3:12; with adv., ἀποτόμως, to deal sharply, 2Co 13:10; with dative of person(s) (cl.), to treat, deal with, At 27:3.†
(AS)

G5531.def:
χράω, κίχρημι
[in LXX for לָוָה, etc. ;]
to lend: Lc 11:5.†
(AS)

G5532.def:
χρεία, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX: 2Cr 2:16 (15) (צֹרֶךְ), Et 7:20 (חַשְׁחוּת) frequently in Sir.1:1-30 -2 Mac ;]
__1. need, necessity: At 28:10, Tt 3:14; πρὸς οἰκοδομὴν τῆς χ. (RV, txt., for edifying as the need may be; but see Field, Notes, 192), Ef 4:29; ἕστι χ., Lc 10:42, Hb 7:11; χ. ἔχειν, with genitive, Mt 6:8 21:3, Mc 11:3, Lc 9:11 15:7 19:31, 34 22:71, Jo 13:29, 1Co 12:21 12:24, 1Ts 4:12, Hb 10:36, Ap 21:23 22:5; before τοῦ, with inf. (Bl., § 71, 3), Hb 5:12; absol. (sc. genitive), At 2:45 4:35; with genitive of person(s), Mt 9:12 26:65, Mc 2:17 14:63, Lc 5:31; with inf. (Bl., § 69, 5), Mt 3:14 14:16, Jo 13:10, 1Ts 1:8 4:9; before ἵνα, Jo 16:30, 1Jo 2:27; absol., Mc 2:25, Ef 4:28, 1Jo 3:17; οὐδὲν χ. ἔχειν, Ap 3:17; ἡ χ., with genitive subjc., Fp 2:25 4:16, 19; pl., At 20:34, Rm 12:13.
__2. matter, business (so esp. in late writers, Polyb., al.; 1Ma.12:45, al.): At 6:3.†
(AS)

G5533.def:
χρεοφειλέτης (Rec. χρεω-, WH, χρεοφιλ-; see WH, App., 152, 154), -ου, ὁ,
(χρέος, a debt, + ὀφειλέτης) [in LXX: Jó 31:37, Pv 29:13 * ;]
a debtor: Lc 7:41 16:5.†
(AS)

G5534.def:
χρή impers.
(χράω, see LS, see word),
it is necessary: Tg 3:10 (cf. δεῖ.).†
(AS)

G5535.def:
χρῄζω
(χρή) [in LXX Jz 11:7, 1Rs 17:18 A * ;]
to need, have need of: with genitive of thing(s), Mt 6:32, Lc 11:8 12:30, 2Co 3:1; with genitive of person(s) before ἐν, Rm 16:2.†
(AS)

G5536.def:
χρῆμα, -τος, τό
(χράομαι) [in LXX: Js 22:8, 2Cr 1:11-12 (נֶכֶס), Jó 27:17 (כֶּסֶף), etc.; frequently in Sir (5:1, 8, al.), 2 and 4 Mac ;]
a thing that one uses or needs (and generally, a matter, event, business); hence in pl.,
__(a) wealth, riches: οἱ τά χ. ἔχοντες, Mc 10:23-24, Lc 18:24;
__(b) money: At 8:18, 20 24:26; sing. (rare in cl.) of a special sum of money, At 4:37.†
(AS)

G5537.def:
χρηματίζω
(χρῆμα), [in LXX: Jr 26:2 29:23 30:2 36:2, 4 A (דָבַר pi.), Jr 25:30) (שָׁאַג), 3Ki.18:27, Jó 40:8 * ;]
__1. to transact business, hence, to consult, deliberate (Thuc., Dem., al.); hence in later writers,
__2. to make answer (esp. of offcial pronounce­ments by magistrates, etc.; in π. of the royal reply to an ἔντευξις, which see; cf. Deiss., BS, 122); of an answer by an oracle (Died., Plut., al.); in FlJ, LXX and NT, of divine communications, to instruct, admonish, warn: pass. (Bl., § 54, 3), Mt 2:22, Hb 8:5 11:7 12:25; with inf. (Bl., § 69,4; 70, 3; 72, 5), Mt 2:12, Lc 2:26, At 10:22
__3. to assume a name (as in business), be called (Polyb., al.): At 11:26, Rm 7:3 (gnomic fut.; cf. Burton, § 69).†
(AS)

G5538.def:
χρηματισμός, -οῦ), ὁ
(χρηματίζω, which see), [in LXX: Pv 31:1 (מַשָּׂא), 2Ma.2:4 2Mac 11:17 * ;]
a divine response, an oracle: Rm 11:4 (Xen., Plat., al.).†
(AS)

G5540.def:
χρῆσις, -εως, ἡ
(χράομαι), [in LXX: 1Rs 1:28 (שָׁאַל), Sir.18:8, al. ;]
use: in a sexual sense, Rm 1:26; with genitive obj., θηλείας, Rm 1:27 (for exx., see Thayer, see word).†
(AS)

G5542.def:
χρηστολογία, -ας, ἡ
(χρηστός, λέγω),
fair speaking: in bad sense, Rm 16:18 (in good sense also, eccl.).†
(AS)

G5543.def:
χρηστός, -ή, -όν
(χράομαι), [in LXX chiefly for טוֹב (frequently of God: Sl 25:8, al.), also for יָקָר (Eze.27:22 28:13), יָשָׁר (Pv 2:21 א A) ;]
serviceable, good;
__(a) of things, good, pleasant: of food (as often in cl.), οἶνος, Lc 5:39; ζυγός, Mt 11:30 (EV, easy); in ethical sense, ἤθη, 1Co 15:33;
__(b) of persons, good, kind, gracious: Ef 4:32; of God, Lc 6:35, 1Pe 2:3; τ. χρηστὸν (= ἡ χρηστότης) τοῦ θεοῦ, Rm 2:4.
† (AS)

G5544.def:
χρηστότης, -ητος, ἡ
(χρηστός), [in LXX for טוּב and cogn. forms ;]
__1. goodness, excellence, uprightness: Rm 3:12 (LXX).
__2. goodness of heart, kindness: Rm 2:4, 2Co 6:6, Gl 5:22, Cl 3:12, Tt 3:4; before ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), Ef 2:7; id., opposite to ἀποτομία, Rm 11:22.
SYN.: see: ἀγαθωσύνη. (AS)

G5545.def:
χρίσμα (T, χρῖσμα, as in cl.; see Tdf., Pr., 102; Bl., § 4, 2), -τος, το
(χρίω),
later form of χρῖμα (Æsch., al.),
[in LXX for מִשְׁחָה and cogn. forms (Êx 29:7, al.) ;]
an anointing, unction (the result of the action χρίειν; ICC, in l; but cf. Westc., in l, for the view that the oil, not the act, is meant): 1Jo 2:20 Jn 2:27.†
(AS)

G5546.def:
Χριστιανός (D, Χρεισ-; on the form Χρησ-, see Bl., § 3, 6; 27, 4 on the ending, -ανος, see Bl., ll. with; Deiss., LAE, 382), -οῦ ὁ,
a Christian, the name first given to the disciples by pagan gentiles at Antioch: At 11:26 26:28, 1Pe 4:16 (see reff. in Thayer, see word; also DB, i, 384).†
(AS)

G5547.def:
χριστός (Χρ-), -ή, -όν
(χρίω), [in LXX for מָשִׁיחַ and cogn. forms ;]
__1. 1. as adj.,
__(a) of things, anointing, to be used as ointment (Æsch., Eur., al.; τ. ἔλαιον τὸ χ., Lv 21:10);
__(b) of persons, anointed (ὁ ἰερεὺς ὁ χ., Lv 4:5; οἱ χ. ἰευρεῖς, 2Ma.1:10): ὁ χ. τοῦ κυρίου or Θεοῦ (1Rs 2:10, Sl 2:2, al.), of the Messiah (Aram., מְשִׁיחָא; cf. Dalman, Words, 289 ff.), Lc 2:11, 26 Jo 1:41, At 2:36 4:26, al.
__2. As subst., ὁ Χριστός, the Messiah, the Christ: Mt 2:4, Mc 8:29, Lc 2:11, Jo 1:20, At 2:31, Rm 7:4, al.; Ἰησοῦς, Mc 1:1, Jo 1:17, At 2:38, al.; Χ. Ἰησοῦς, Mt 1:18, WH, mg. At 5:42, Rm 6:3, al.; Χ. κύριος, Lc 2:11; Ἰησοῦς Χ. ὁ κύριος, At 15:26, Rm 1:7, al.
(AS)

G5548.def:
χρίω
to anoint (Hom., al.);
[in LXX chiefly for מָשַׁח of consecration to a sacred office: priest, Êx 28:41; prophet, 3Ki.19:16; king, 1Rs 10:1; of things, Êx 40:9, Lv 8:10, al.].
In NT, metaphorically, of God's anointing,
__(a) Christ: At 4:27; with inf., Lc 4:18 (LXX); with dupl. accusative (see B1., § 34, 4), Hb 1:9 (LXX); πνεύματι ἁγίῳ, At 10:38;
__(b) Christians: 2Co 1:21 (cf. Westc., Epp. Jo., 73) (cf. ἐν-, ἐπι-Χριω).†
SYN: see: ἀλείφω
(AS)

G5549.def:
χρονίζω
(χρόνος), [in LXX chiefly for אָחַר pi. ;]
to spend or take time, to tarry, linger, delay: Mt 24:48 25:5, Hb 10:37; before ἐν, with dative loc., Lc 1:21; with inf., Lc 12:45.†
(AS)

G5550.def:
χρόνος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for יוֹם, also for עֵת, etc. ;]
time (a space of time, whether long or short; cf. Lft., Notes, 70): Mt 2:7, Mc 9:21, Lc 1:57, At 3:21 7:17, 23 13:18 17:30 27:9, Hb 11:32, 1Pe 1:17 4:3, Ap 10:6; στιγμὴ χρόνου, Lc 4:5; πλήρωμα τοῦ χ., Gl 4:4; ποιεῖν χ., At 15:33 18:23; βιῶσαι, 1Pe 4:2; διδόναι, Ap 2:21; pl., χ. καὶ (ἢ) καιροί (Lft., l.with), At 1:7, 1Ts 5:1; ἐπ᾽ ἐσχάτου τῶν χ. (χρόνου), 1Pe 1:20, Ju 18; with prep., ἄχρι, At 3:21; διὰ τὸν χ., Hb 5:12; ἐν χ., At 1:6, 21; ἐπὶ (πλείονα) χ., Lc 18:4, At 18:20; ἐφ᾽ ὅσον χ., Rm 7:1, 1Co 7:39, Gl 4:1; κατὰ τὸν χ., Mt 2:16; μετὰ τολὺν (τοσοῦτον) χ., Mt 25:19, Hb 4:7; πρὸ χ. αἰωςίων, 2Tm 1:9, Tt 1:2, instr. dative of extension of time (see M, Pr., 75, 148; Deiss., LAE, 206), Lc 8:27, 29 Jo 14:9, At 8:11, Rm 16:25; accusative, of duration of time, Mc 2:19, Lc 20:9, Jo 5:6 7:33 12:35 14:9, At 14:3, 28 19:22 20:18, 1Co 16:7, Ap 6:11.†
SYN.: see: καιρός (AS)

G5552.def:
Χρύσεος, -εα, -εον (-οῦς, -ῆ, -οῦν; on accusative sing. fem., -ᾶν, Ap 1:13 and genitive pl. uncontr., -εων, Ap 2:1, LTr., see M, Pr., 48 and cf. Thackeray, Gr., x, 172 f.)
(χρυσός), [in LXX chiefly for זָהָב ;]
golden, i.e. made or overlaid with gold: 2Tm 2:20, Hb 9:4, Ap 1:12-13, 20 2:1 4:4 5:8 8:3 9:13, 20 14:14 15:6-7 17:4 21:15.†
(AS)

G5553.def:
χρυσίον, -ου, τό
(dimin. of χρυσός, which see), [in LXX chiefly for זָהָב ;]
a piece of gold, gold: 1Co 3:12, Hb 9:4, 1Pe 1:7, Ap 3:18 21:18, 21; of golden ornaments, 1Tm 2:9 (WH, txt., RV), 1Pe 3:3, Ap 17:4 18:16 (WH, txt., R); of gold coin, money, At 3:6 20:33, 1Pe 1:18.†
(AS)

G5555.def:
χρυσό-λιθος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: Êx 28:20 36:20 (Êx 39:13), Eze.28:13 (תַּרְשִׁישׁ) * ;]
a chrysolite (on its identification, see Swete, Ap., 288 f.; DB, iv, 620): Ap 21:20.†
(AS)

G5557.def:
χρυσός, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for זָהָב ;]
gold: Mt 2:11, Ap 9:7; of golden ornaments, Mt 23:16-17, 1Tm 2:9 (Rec., WH, mg.), Tg 5:3, Ap 17:4 (Rec., WH, mg.) Ap 18:12, 16 (Rec., WH, mg.); of images, At 17:29; of gold coin, Mt 10:9.†
(AS)

G5558.def:
χρυσόω, -ῶ
(χρυσός) [in LXX chiefly for צָפָה pi. ;]
to gild, cover with gold: pass., with dative, χρυσίῳ (pleonast., cf. Êx 26:37), Ap 17:4 18:16.†
(AS)

G5559.def:
χρώς, genitive, χρωτός, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for בָּשָׂר ;]
in cl. rare in prose, the surface of the body, skin: At 19:12.†
(AS)

G5561.def:
χώρα, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX for אֶרֶץ, מְדִינָה, etc. ;]
__1. most frequently in cl., a space, place.
__2. land, i.e.
__(a) a land, country, region: Mt 12:2, Mc 5:10 6:55, Lc 2:8 15:13-15 19:12, Jo 11:54, At 13:49 27:27; χ. Γαλατική, At 16:6 18:23; Τραχωνίτιδος, Lc 3:1; τ. Ἰουδαίας, At 26:20; τ. Ἰουδαίων, At 10:39; pl., τῆς Ἰουδαίας κ. Σαμαρείας, At 8:1; Γεργεσηνῶν (Γερασηνῶν, Γαδαρηνῶν) Mt 8:28, Mc 5:1, Lc 8:26; ἐν χ. καὶ σκιᾷ θανάτου, Mt 4:16;
__(b) land, property: Lc 12:16;
__(with) the country, opposite to the town; so in pl., Lc 21:21, Jo 4:35, Tg 5:4.†
SYN.: ἄγρος, τόπος (cf. DCG, i, 591a; LS, see word χώρα, ad init.). (AS)

G5562.def:
χωρέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Gn 13:6 (נָשָׂא), 3Ki.7:26 7:38 (כּוּל hi.), 2Cr 4:5 (חָזַק hi.), Wis.7:23-24, al. ;]
__I. Intrans.,
__1. to make room, give way, retire, pass: before εἰς, Mt 15:17; metaphorically (EV, come), εἰς μετάνοιαν, 2Pe 3:9.
__2. to go forward, advance, progress (Plat., Polyb., al.) ὁ λόγος ὁ ἐμὸς οὐ χωρεῖ. ἐν ὑμῖν, Jo 8:37 (R, txt., hath not free course; R, mg., hath no place, for WH. cf. Field, Notes, 94 f.).
__II. Trans., to have space for holding, to hold: Mc 2:2 (cf. Ge, l.with), Jo 21:25; of measures (1Ki, 2Ch, ll. with), Jo 2:6. Metaphorical, of having or making room in mind or heart: Mt 19:11-12 (EV, receive), 2Co 7:2 (R, txt., open your hearts; mg., make room) (cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο-, ἐκ-, ὑπο-χωρέω).†
(AS)

G5563.def:
χωρίζω
[in LXX: 2Cr 12:8, al. (בָּדַל ni., etc.), Wis.1:3, 2Ma.5:21, al. ;]
__1. to separate, divide, put asunder: with accusative of thing(s), opposite to συζεύγνυμι Mt 19:6, Mc 10:9; with accusative of person(s), before ἀπό (Wis.1:3), Rm 8:35, 39; pf. pass ptcp., Hb 7:26.
__2. In late writers, mid. and 1 aor pass., to separate oneself, depart: Phm 15; before ἀπό At 1:4, ἐκ, At 18:1-2; of divorce (polyb., al.), 1Co 7:10-11 7:15 (cf. ἀπο-, δια-χωρίζω).†
(AS)

G5564G.def:
χωρίον, -ου, τό
(dimin. of χώρα, χῶρος), [in LXX: 1Cr 27:27 (כֶּרֶם), 2Ma.11:5 2Mac 12:7 2Mac 12:21, 4Ma.15:20 * ;]
__1. a place, region.
__2. an estate, property, piece of land: Mt 26:36, Mc 14:32, Jo 4:5, At 1:18-19 4:34 5:3, 8 28:7.†
(AS)

G5564H.def:
χωρίον, -ου, τό
(dimin. of χώρα, χῶρος), [in LXX: 1Cr 27:27 (כֶּרֶם), 2Ma.11:5 2Mac 12:7 2Mac 12:21, 4Ma.15:20 * ;]
__1. a place, region.
__2. an estate, property, piece of land: Mt 26:36, Mc 14:32, Jo 4:5, At 1:18-19 4:34 5:3, 8 28:7.†
(AS)

G5565.def:
χωρίς
adv.,
__1. separately, apart: Jo 20:7.
__2. As prep., with genitive,
__(a) separate from, apart from, without (practically equiv. to ἄνευ; see Field, Notes, 103): Mt 13:34, Mc 4:34, Lc 6:49, Jo 1:3 15:5, Rm 3:21, 28 4:6 7:8-9 10:14, 1Co 4:8 11:11, 2Co 12:3, Ef 2:12, Fp 2:14, 1Tm 2:8 5:21, Phm 14, Hb 4:15 7:7, 20 9:7, 18 9:22, 28 10:25 11:6, 40 12:8, 14 (οὗ χωρίς; see Bl., § 82, 3), Tg 2:18, 20 2:26;
__(b) besides: Mt 14:21 15:38, 2Co 11:28.†
(AS)

G5567.def:
ψάλλω
[in LXX chiefly for זָמַר pi. (Jz 5:3, Sl 7:17, al.), also for נָגַן pi. (1Rs 16:16 ff, al.) ;]
__1. to pull, twitch, twang (as a bowstring, etc.; Æsch., Eur., al.), hence,
__2. absol.,
__(a) to play a stringed instrument with the fingers (Hdt., Plat., al.);
__(b) later, to sing to a harp, sing psalms (LXX); in NT, to sing a hymn, sing praise: Tg 5:13; with dative of person(s), Rm 15:9 (LXX), Ef 5:19; dative instr., 1Co 14:15.†
(AS)

G5568.def:
ψαλμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ψάλλω), [in LXX chiefly for מִזְמוֹר ;]
__1. a striking, twitching with the fingers (Eur., al.), hence, a striking of musical strings (Æsch., a1.), and hence in later writers,
__2. a sacred song sung to musical accompaniment, a psalm (LXX): 1Co 14:26, Ef 5:19, Cl 3:16; of OT psalms, Lc 24:44, At 13:33; βίβλος ψαλμῶν, Lc 20:42, At 1:20.†
SYN.: see: ὕμνος (AS)

G5569.def:
ψευδ-άδελφος, -ου, ὁ
a false brother: of professing Christians, 2Co 11:26, Gl 2:4.†
(AS)

G5571.def:
ψευδής, -ές
(ψεύδομαι), [in LXX for שֶׁקֶר, שָׁוְא, כָּזָב; etc. ;]
lying, false, untrue (of persons and things): Ap 2:2; μάρτυρες, At 6:13; as subst., ὁ ψ., a liar: Ap 21:8.†
(AS)

G5574.def:
ψεύδω to deceive by lies; more frequently in the depon. mid, form ψεύδομαι (so always in NT),
[in LXX chiefly for כָּחַשׁ pi. ;]
__1. absol., to lie: Hb 6:18, 1Jo 1:6, Ap 3:9; οὐ ψεύδομαι, Rm 9:1, 2Co 11:31, Gl 1:20, 1Tm 2:7 with dative of person(s) (Sl 18:45, Jo 5:12, al.), At 5:4; before εἰς, Cl 3:9; κατά, Tg 3:14 (Hort, in l).
__2. Like act., with accusative, to deceive by lies (Æsch., al.): At 5:3.†
(AS)

G5575.def:
ψευδο-μάρτυς, -υρος, ὁ
[in LXX: Dan LXX Su 1:60-61 Bl * ;]
a false witness: Mt 26:60; with genitive obj. (see WM, § 30, 1a), 1Co 15:15.†
(AS)

G5576.def:
ψευδο-μαρτυρέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Êx 20:16, Dt 5:20 (17) (עָנָה), Da TH Su 1:61 AB2R (see ψευδομάρτυς) * ;]
to bear false witness: Mt 19:18, Mc 10:19, Lc 18:20" (LXX) ; before κατά, with genitive of person(s), Mc 14:56-57 (Xen., Plat., al.).†
(AS)

G5578.def:
ψευδο-προφήτης, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: Zc 13:2, Jr 1:9 (Jr 6:13, al.) (נָבִיא)* ;]
a false prophet (= cl. ψευδόμαντις): Mt 7:15 24:11, 24, Mc 13:22 (see Swete, in l), Lc 6:26, At 13:6, 2Pe 2:1, 1Jo 4:1, Ap 16:13 19:20 20:10 †
(AS)

G5579.def:
ψεῦδος, -εος (-ους), τό
[in LXX chiefly for שֶׁקֶר, also for כַּחַשׁ, כָּזָב ;]
a falsehood, untruth, lie: Ap 14:15; opposite to ἡ ἀλήθεια, Jo 8:44, Rm 1:25, Ef 4:25, 2Ts 2:11, 1Jo 2:21; to τὸ ἀληθές, 1Jo 2:27; ποιεῖν ψ., Ap 21:27 22:15; ἐν πάσῃ δυνάμει κ. σημείοις κ. τέρασιν ψεύδους (genitive qual., see M, Th., 104; and on the meaning and construction, see also ICC, in l), 2Ts 2:9.†
(AS)

G5580.def:
ψευδό-χριστος, -ου ὁ
a false Christ or Messiah, "a pretender to the Messianic office" (Swete, Mk., 309; cf. also Tr., Syn., § xxx): Mt 24:24, Mc 13:22 (cf. ἀντίχριστος).†
(AS)

G5581.def:
ψευδώνυμος, -ον
(ψευδής, ὄνομα)
under a false name, falsely called: 1Tm 6:20 (Æsch., Plut., a1.).†
(AS)

G5582.def:
ψεῦσμα, -τος, τό
(ψεύδω), [in Aq., Th.: Jó 34:6, Pv 23:3; in Sm.: Jó 13:4, al. ;]
a lie, falsehood: Rm 3:7 (Plat., Plut. al.).†
(AS)

G5584.def:
ψηλαφάω, -ῶ
(ψάω, to touch), [in LXX for מוּשׁ, מָשַׁשׁ pi., etc. ;]
__1. to feel or grope about; with accusative, to feel about for, search after: metaphorically, of seeking God, At 17:27.
__2. to feel, touch, handle: with accusative of person(s), Lc 24:39, 1Jo 1:1; προσεληλύθατε ψηλαφωμένῳ (ὄρει ?), Hb 12:18 (R, txt., a mount that might be touched; mg., a palpable and kindled fire; see Westc., in l).†
(AS)

G5585.def:
ψηφίζω
(ψῆφος), [in LXX: 3Ki.3:8 8:5 A (סָפַר ni..) * ;]
to count (prop., with pebbles), reckon, calculate: τ. δαπάνην, Lc 14:28; τ. ἀριθμόν (i.e. calculate the number's meaning), Ap 13:18 (in cl. chiefly mid., to vote by casting a pebble; cf. συγ-κατα-, συμ-φηφίζω).†
(AS)

G5586G.def:
ψῆφος, -ου, ἡ
(ψάω, to rub) [in LXX: Êx 4:25 (צֹר), La 3:16 (חָצָץ), Ec 7:26 (25) (צֹר), 4Ki.12:4 (5) A, Sir.18:10, 4Ma.15:26 * ;]
__1. a small smooth stone, a pebble: ψ. λευκή (for suggestions as to the meaning, see Swete, in l), Ap 2:17.
__2. From the use of pebbles in voting, a vote: At 26:10.†
(AS)

G5586H.def:
ψῆφος, -ου, ἡ
(ψάω, to rub) [in LXX: Êx 4:25 (צֹר), La 3:16 (חָצָץ), Ec 7:26 (25) (צֹר), 4Ki.12:4 (5) A, Sir.18:10, 4Ma.15:26 * ;]
__1. a small smooth stone, a pebble: ψ. λευκή (for suggestions as to the meaning, see Swete, in l), Ap 2:17.
__2. From the use of pebbles in voting, a vote: At 26:10.†
(AS)

G5587.def:
ψιθυρισμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ψιθυρίζω, to whisper), [in LXX: Ec 10:11 (לַחַשׁ) * ;]
a whispering;
__(a) of secret slander, 2Co 12:20 (Plut.);
__(b) of a murmured enchantment, Ec, l.with†
(AS)

G5588.def:
ψιθυριστής, -οῦ, ὁ
(see supr.),
a whisperer (as epithet of Hermes, Dem., 1358, 6): in bad sense, Rm 1:30.†
Syn.: καταλάλος, q.v
(AS)

G5589.def:
ψιχίον, -ου, τό
dimin. of ψίξ,
a crumb: Mt 15:27, Mc 7:28.†
(AS)

G5590G.def:
ψυχή, -ῆς, ἡ,
[in LXX very frequently for נֶפֶשׁ, sometimes for לֵבַב ,לֵב, etc. ;]
__1. breath (Lat. anima), breath of life, life (Hom., al.; in Arist., of the vital principle): Mt 6:25, Mc 3:4 10:45, Lc 12:22, Jo 10:11, At 20:10, 24 2Co 1:23, Fp 2:30, 1Ts 2:8, al.
__2. the soul,
__(a) as the seat of the will, desires and affections: Mt 26:38, Mc 12:30" (LXX) 14:34, Lc 1:46, Jo 10:24, At 14:2, Fp 1:27, al.; ἐκ ψυχῆς, from the heart, heartily: Ef 6:6, Cl 3:23;
__(b) as a periphrasis for person or self (frequently in translation from Semitic originals, see M, Pr., 87; Robinson, Gospels, 113ff.; but also frequently in cl., see LS, see word II, 2; Edwards, Lex., App. A.): Mt 11:29, Mc 8:36, At 2:41, Rm 2:9, 1Pe 3:20, al.; πᾶσα ψ., At 2:43 3:23" (LXX), Rm 13:1; ψ. ζῶσα (ζωῆς), 1Co 15:45, Ap 16:3;
__(with) as the object of divine grace and eternal salvation: Hb 13:17, Tg 1:21 5:20, 1Pe 1:9, 22 2:11 4:19, 3Jo.2.
SYN.: see: νοῦς, πνεῦμα, ψυχικός, and cf. ICC on 1Ts 5:23, Lft., Notes, 88f. (AS)

ψυχή, -ῆς, ἡ,
[in LXX very frequently for נֶפֶשׁ, sometimes for לֵבַב ,לֵב, etc. ;]

__2. the soul,

__(with) as the object of divine grace and eternal salvation: Hb 13:17, Tg 1:21 5:20, 1Pe 1:9, 22 2:11 4:19, 3Jo.2.

ψυχή, -ῆς, ἡ,
[in LXX very frequently for נֶפֶשׁ, sometimes for לֵבַב ,לֵב, etc. ;]
__1. breath (Lat. anima), breath of life, life (Hom., al.; in Arist., of the vital principle): Mt 6:25, Mc 3:4 10:45, Lc 12:22, Jo 10:11, At 20:10, 24 2Co 1:23, Fp 2:30, 1Ts 2:8, al.

G5591.def:
ψυχικός, -ή, -όν
(ψυχή) [in LXX: 4Ma.1:32 * ;]
of the ψυχή (as the lower part of the immaterial in man), EV, natural: opposite to πνευματικός, 1Co 2:14 15:44 15:46; πνεῦμα μὴ ἔχοντες (EV, sensual; R, mg., natural or animal; better perhaps, of the mind; see infr.), Ju 19; with ἐπίγειος, δαιμονιώδης, opposite to ἄνωθεν κατερχομένη (σοψία), of the mind (Hort, in l), Tg 3:15†
(AS)

G5592.def:
ψύχος (LT, ψῦ-, as in cl.), -εος (-ους), τό
(ψύχω), [in LXX: Gn 8:22 (קֹר), Jó 37:9, Sl 147:17 (קָרָה), Zc 14:6, Dan LXX TH 3:67,69 * ;]
cold: Jo 18:18, At 28:2, 2Co 11:27.†
(AS)

G5593.def:
ψυχρός, -ά, -όν
(ψύχω), [in LXX: Pv 25:25 (קַר), Sir.43:20, 4Ma.11:26 * ;]
cold: sc. ὕδωρ (cf. Theogn., 263; Hdt., ii, 37), Mt 10:42; metaphorically, of indifferent persons, Ap 3:15-16 †
(AS)

G5594.def:
ψύχω
[in LXX for קוּר, שָׁטַח ;]
to breathe, blow; hence, to make cool. Pass., to grow cool: metaphorically, Mt 24:12.†
(AS)

G5595.def:
ψωμίζω
(ψωμός, a morsel), [in LXX chiefly for אָכַל hi. ;]
to feed with morsels (as children or the sick; Hippocr.), hence, generally, in late writers, to feed, nourish: with accusative of person(s), Rm 12:20 (LXX); with accusative of thing(s), to give out for food, 1Co 13:3 (cf. WM, § 32, 4an; for dupl. accusative, cf. Nm 11:4, Sir.15:3, al.).†
(AS)

G5596.def:
ψωμίον, -ου, τό
dimin. of ψωμός, a fragment, morsel: Jo 13:26-27, 30.†
(AS)

G5597.def:
ψώχω
(ψώω, collat. form of ψάω, to rub)
to rub: Lc 6:1.†
(AS)

G5598.def:
Ω, ω, ὦ μέγα (cf. ὂ μικρόν),
omega, ô, the twenty-fourth and last letter. As a numeral, ω᾽ = 800, ω, = 800,000. As a symbol of the last (= τὸ τέλος), τὸ Ὦ (Rec. Ω, L, ὦ, T, ω), the Omega: Ap 1:8 21:6 22:13 (cf. Ἄλφα).†
(AS)

G5599.def:
ὦ
interj., with vocat.,
O;
__(a) in simple address (less frequently than in cl.; M, Pr., 71); At 1:1 18:14 27:21, Rm 2:1, 3 9:20, 1Tm 6:20; expressing reproof, Tg 2:20;
__(b) in exclamations of surprise, etc.: Mt 15:28, Lc 24:25, At 13:10, Rm 11:33, Gl 3:1; with nom. (Bl., § 33, 4), Mt 17:17, Mc 9:19, Lc 9:41.†
(AS)
